    candidate_list = {

            limit = {

                NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
                any_owned_location = {
                    OR = {
                        area = area:thrace_area
                        area = area:macedonia_area
                        area = area:northern_greece_area
                        area = area:morea_area
                        area = area:marmara_area
                        area = area:west_anatolia_area
                    }
                }
            }
            add_to_list = source
        }
    }
    score = {
        add = scope:target.country_tax_base
        multiply = 6
        add = 20
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:target = {
                    any_owned_location = {
                        OR = {
                            area = area:thrace_area

                }
            }
            add = 25
        }
    }
    sort_value = {
        add = scope:target.country_tax_base

        add = 20

}

# Dynamic Anti-Hegemon (Slot 67): when global hegemon suffers High Entropy (oe_ent_index >= 60),
# neighboring threatened majors actively seize the counter-strike window! (O(1) direct target lookup)
oe_heg_ai_counterstrike_target = {
    attacker_potential = {
        oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_major = yes
        oe_heg_ai_hegemon_high_entropy = yes
        at_war = no
        stability >= 0
    }
    candidate_list = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
            global_var:oe_heg_ai_target = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        is_neighbor_of = root
                        NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
                        NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
                    }
                    add_to_list = source
                }
            }
        }
    }
    score = {
        add = 65
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            add = 35
        }
    }
    sort_value = {
        add = 120
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            add = 60
        }
    }
}
